messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: inference-prod-us-west2 — 99th-percentile token latency > 5s for last 3m. Triage bridge: https://meet/incident-2712349999. Oncall: @Ken
Ken: on it. joining bridge, looking at the GPU pool and autoscaler logs.
Marie: I'm on the bridge too — can we confirm whether Dedicated nodes are impacted or just Hosted?
Ken: preliminary looks: host-gpu-pool-3 shows high GPU memory occupancy, repeated KV cache evictions. Starting soft restart of runner on node-3 (no full deploy).
incident-bot: action: restart initiated on node-3 @ 2712350200
Ken: restart finished, tail latency trending down. Keeping bridge open for 15m to observe. Initial customer impact: rough count shows ~12 customers with slow responses, 2 retried requests surfaced so far.
Angel: collecting traces and putting artifacts into the incident folder: s3://redwood-incidents/2712349999. Running query to enumerate affected requests: ```select count(*) from requests where latency_ms > 5000 and region = 'us-west2' and ts > now() - interval '15 minutes';```
Marie: thanks @Angel — please flag any model eviction spikes or unexpected scale events. We need a short customer-impact blurb for ops/legal once we have counts.
Sam: metrics summary: error rate bump from 0.4% -> 0.9% between 02:12-02:20 UTC, p99 latency peaked ~12s, normalized after restart. No signs of data exfiltration. Customer-visible: increased 5xx and slow token responses.
Priya: proposed postmortem slot: 2026-03-19 10:30 PT (doc + walk). Draft owners: @Ken (timeline + mitigation), @Angel (logs + evidence), @Marie (customer impact & comms). Peer reviewer: @Jade. OK?
Ken: works for me. I'll drop a timeline draft by EOD and link the doc here.
Angel: uploading spans + raw logs, will include the query outputs and correlate with autoscaler events.
Marie: action items (summary):
- Improve cache-warm on scale-up (owner: Ken) — target due 2026-03-24
- Adjust alert threshold to consider p95 moving window and reduce noise (owner: Priya) — target due 2026-03-20
- Postmortem draft (owners: Ken/Angel/Marie) — target due 2026-03-19
- Customer outreach draft (owner: Marie) — target due 2026-03-20
Please add any additional items. :spiral_notepad:
Ken: created GH issues: #4287 "cache-warm on scale" and #4288 "alert-threshold-p95-moving-window". linking them in the doc.
Jade: I'll review the draft and run a quick peer review on 2026-03-19 11:00 PT.
Marie: closing the bridge now; continuing to monitor for 30m. If anything regresses re-open the bridge or ping oncall. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Ken: noted. I'll update the timeline with exact timestamps and mitigation commands used (soft restart command and logs).
Angel: pasted the important logs into the doc; sample snippet for debugging: ```
[2026-03-17T02:14:08Z] node-3 evicting kv_cache: size=1.2GB -> 0.2GB, reason=mem_pressure
[2026-03-17T02:14:12Z] runner-restart started pid=4213
[2026-03-17T02:14:35Z] runner-restart complete status=ok
```
Marie: added customer impact note to the draft: "~12 customers experienced degraded responses; we observed increased retries but no data loss. SLO miss window ~8 minutes."
Priya: I'll follow up with monitoring tweaks and add a dashboard annotation for the incident window.
Jade: once the draft is in, I'll do a focused review on contributing factors and action clarity.
Marie: thanks — postmortem doc link (will be posted here once created). Everyone, please add your evidence links and GH issues to the doc so the peer review can be fast.
